ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.global_contrast_ratio: Predominantly low-intensity (black) surface with approximately 15-20% high-intensity (white) coverage concentrated at the distal lobe extremities.
ventral_fluke_pixel_intensity_distributi.spatial_color_mapping: High-intensity white blobs are localized at the lateral distal margins of both lobes. The left lobe tip features an irregular, contiguous white patch with feathered interior edges. The right lobe tip features a more fragmented white pattern. The central and proximal regions are consistently low-intensity black.

trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.median_notch_angle: Deep, acute V-shaped central depression with clearly defined converging linear boundaries.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.edge_topography_serration_map: Frequent low-amplitude serrations along the entire trailing edge boundary. Significant high-amplitude irregular protrusions are present at the extreme lateral tips of both lobes, disrupting the smooth linear contour.
trailing_edge_2d_geometric_contour.lobe_sweep_trajectory: Symmetrical upward and outward convex curvature originating from the median notch and terminating at the distal tips.

localized_surface_anomalies.rosette_scar_constellations: High-density white pixel clusters located at the distal tips of both lobes. Scattered individual circular white punctate marks are visible across the dark ventral surface, particularly on the left mid-lobe region.
localized_surface_anomalies.linear_abrasions: Several thin, light-colored linear pixel disruptions; notably a diagonal mark on the interior right lobe and a short horizontal mark on the mid-left lobe.

acquired_anomalies_or_scars: Prominent irregular structural protrusions at the distal tips of both lobes, characterized by high-contrast white and textured pixel groupings.
